sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Standby to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery.

Incident review (5 September, approx. 11:30pm–12:00am): after reviewing camera footage, a suspicious male was captured roaming the building and seen on Level 4 kicking in a door he had no access to. He was seen scoping the room but appeared to have entered the wrong room, left to collect his food and drinks, then returned to his own room.
Heading out of HQ to commence welfare checks at Localito Convenience Store and McDonald's Queen.
Asked a male street vagrant to move slightly aside so the fire hydrant was not obstructed; he complied without further issue. Welfare check inside the store, all clear.
Back at HQ to continue recharging the Ops Phone. Standby until the second morning-shift guard arrives (running late); previous-shift guard continuing to standby.
Second guard arrived; now on route to patrol, heading up Queen Street.
Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City, all clear. Standby to show presence before moving on.
Check-in at Aotea Square, full scope of the area, all clear. Standby for response calls.
Arrived at the corner intersection of Queen and Victoria Street; patrolling down Queen Street maintaining strong presence.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep completed with welfare checks on all stores, all clear.
Patrolling through Commerce Street and Galway Street, maintaining presence.
Patrolling through Fort Lane, all clear.
Scoped all stores and checked static guards along Fort Street, all clear.
Stopped by Haven Mart Convenience Store; provided our contact details and reassured them we are here to assist with any future issues.
Spoke with guards and staff from North Face on Shortland Street regarding the status of their area, all clear.
Welfare checks along High Street, Freyberg Place and Chancery Square; full sweep completed, no issues, all clear. Standby to show presence and await response calls.
Patrolling up Queen Street, checking in on all stores along the way.
Arrived at Mid City shopping centre, welfare check completed on all stores, no issues to report. Standby to maintain presence.
Arrived at Aotea Square — multiple graduation gift stands present with an ambulance on standby, and an event being set up on the grass. Quick walkthrough, all clear.
Due to rain, maintaining presence in sheltered areas.
Standby to show presence; welfare checks on static guards in the area, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, welfare checks on all stores, all clear.
Welfare check at Timezone and all other stores in the vicinity, all clear.
Patrolling down Queen Street, all clear.
Arrived at HQ for a quick restroom break before continuing patrols.
Welfare check list completed, all clear:
Welfare check at all stores in Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, scoped the area, all clear.
Management requesting presence at HQ for a brief meeting regarding the incident of 5 September.
Arrived at HQ, standby for response calls.
Welfare check inside ANZ Bank, all clear.
Welfare check at Mobile Planet and Bag Planet, all clear.
Welfare check at Cotton On, all clear.
Welfare check completed at McDonald's Queen Street and Unichem Pharmacy, all clear.
Arrived back at HQ, standby to begin lunch break while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check completed at Nike, all clear.
Welfare and follow-up check at Liquor City Victoria Street; police had visited and spoken with the store owner about the previous incident.
Arrived back at HQ, continuing break.
Break concluded; standby to recharge the Ops Phone for the Afternoon Shift.
Equipment handover: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing patrols; fire alarm has been deactivated, no issues to report.
Arrived at Pocket Park; welfare checks and survey collection from stores, all clear:
Arrived at TK Square, welfare checks:
Commercial Bay guards reported a female POI who stole from one of their stores (Oriton). Advised we will keep an eye out for the POI while on patrol and retrieve stolen goods if located.
Standing by at TK Square, maintaining presence and watching for any issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby, no issues to report.
Arrived at lower Albert Street, welfare checks on stores — all clear, nothing to report (taking cover due to weather):
Response call from the pastor of St Patrick's Cathedral regarding a male vagrant who keeps urinating on the church; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at St Patrick's Cathedral; pastor identified the vagrant. Interacted with the male and advised him to vacate the area. Standing by.
Issued the male vagrant a verbal trespass from St Patrick's Cathedral; shadowing him from afar as he remains on the property.
Response call from K Save Mart regarding a male vagrant sleeping outside the store; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at K Save Mart; male vagrant spotted. Standing by as he may have taken some substances; paramedics have been contacted. (Photo on file.)
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing full sweep with welfare checks at JFC and Skyworld Entertainment.
Full sweep complete and welfare checks done, no issues to report.
Arrived at Queens Court, welfare checks at Munster Inn, Nandos, Queens Convenience.
Welfare checks completed, all clear. Heading down Queen Street with welfare checks along the way:

During welfare checks, Unichem Queen Street flagged a female POI inside acting suspiciously and asked us to stand by in case she steals; members of the public reported she had tried to chase minors. (Photo on file.)
Unichem Queen Street manager requested she be removed from the store.
Female POI successfully removed from the premises. Standing by in case she returns.
Leaving standby; POI out of sight and has not returned. Heading back to HQ for a quick toilet break and floor checks.
Arrived at Darby Street, welfare checks at Celines, Mali Thai, Tandoori, Pizza Club, Domino's, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street / Victoria Street West, welfare checks, all clear:
Arrived at top of Victoria Street West, welfare checks, nothing to report:
Arrived at St Patrick's Square / Cathedral.
Personally notified by a member of Footlocker Queen Street that our HQ entrance door was open and not closed.
Arrived at HQ; standing by as the door is not closing, remaining vigilant for response calls.
Arrived at TK Square, welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, no issues to report.
TK Square sweep complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at Fort Street, welfare checks, all clear:
Welfare checks on the above complete, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square, welfare checks on stores, all clear.
Freyberg Square / Chancery Square sweep complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street / Victoria Street East, welfare checks, all clear:
Arrived at Lorne Street fountain, standing by for nearby response calls and watching for issues or vagrants.
Arrived at Queen Street, welfare checks, all clear:
Maintaining presence on Queen Street for the public and businesses still open.
Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone due to low battery.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding minors causing a disturbance inside; assistance requested to remove them.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart — minors had left the store but remain in the area. Standing by in case they re-enter.
Minors have gone towards Viaduct Harbour and left the area. Heading back to HQ for handover to Night Shift.
Arrived at HQ, standby for handover to Night Shift.
Afternoon shift concluded, handover to Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Night shift deployed; commencing debrief with afternoon shift before heading out.
Received a call from management requesting guard cover at 55 Anzac Street; gearing up and en route.
Arrived at High Street, patrolling the area.
High Street all clear; patrolling Vulcan Lane to Queen Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane; patrolling up Queen Street for welfare checks at The Hour Glass.
Welfare check at The Hour Glass, all clear, no vagrants taking shelter. Heading to the location requested by management.
Welfare check Shortland Street, all clear.
Welfare check Jo&Joe's, all clear; patrolling Fort Street.
Welfare check Tribe Hotel, all clear, no issues.
Whole of Fort Street all clear, no issues. Heading to Anzac Avenue as requested by management.
Arrived at the location; called management to advise no one was at check-in. Standing by until the person arrives.
Person has arrived and gave an introduction. Standing by until guard handover.
Guard handover; giving introduction for the guard before heading out to patrols.
Guard introduction at 55 Anzac Avenue, all clear; commencing patrols down to Customs Street.
Welfare check Yeah Road, Anzac Avenue, all clear; patrolling down Customs Street West.
Welfare check Gore Street, all clear.
Welfare check Commerce Street, all clear; arriving at Britomart to commence a sweep.
Arrived at Britomart, commencing sweep and standing by for security presence.
As we entered McDonald's Britomart, staff told us a young female had been inside harassing staff and customers; police in the area. Standing by for any issues. (Photo on file.)
Still at Britomart, standing by maintaining presence.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check McDonald's, stood down police assistance, all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store, all clear; continuing up Queen Street.
Full sweep Queen Street; arriving at McDonald's Queen.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen, all clear, no issues; patrolling up to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep and standing by for any issues.
Still at Aotea Square, standing by maintaining presence.
Full sweep conducted at Aotea Square; patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Rutland Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Lorne staircase and Radisson, all clear; continuing down Lorne Street.
Welfare check whole of Lorne Street, all clear; patrolling through High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place, commencing sweep and maintaining presence.
Welfare check O'Connell Street, Chancery Street, all clear, no issues.
Still at Freyberg Place, maintaining presence and sweeping the area.
Full sweep conducted at Freyberg Place; patrolling down High Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check whole of High Street, all clear; patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check Shortland Street, all clear.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check Queen Street 77 Convenience Store, all clear; arrived at Britomart, commencing sweep.
Standing down patrols; heading back to office to charge Ops Phone due to low battery.
Arrived at office, charging Ops Phone.
Received a call from a fellow guard at Anzac Avenue requesting a spare charger; advised none was in the office. Continuing.
Welfare check Victoria Street West 77 Convenience Store, all clear; patrolling through Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear, no issues; arriving at Federal Square to commence sweep.
Arrived at Federal Square, commencing sweep.
Federal Square all clear; patrolling the bottom half of Federal Street.
Welfare check Swanson Street, all clear.
Whole of Federal Street all clear; patrolling through Fanshawe Street.
Fanshawe Street all clear, no issues; patrolling Customs Street West to lower Albert Street.
Welfare check Customs Street West, all clear; patrolling lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear; patrolling Quay Street to Britomart.
Received a call from a fellow guard at 55 Anzac Avenue requesting cover for a short period to retrieve a belonging; en route.
Arrived at 55 Anzac Avenue, standing by until the guard returns.
Still at 55 Anzac Avenue, standing by.
Stood down from 55 Anzac Avenue, guard has returned; continuing patrols down Customs Street.
Customs Street West all clear; arriving at Britomart to commence sweep.
Arrived at Britomart, commencing sweep and standing by maintaining presence.
Full sweep conducted at Britomart; welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Albert Street.
Patrolled lower Albert Street, all clear; continuing up Albert Street.
Albert Convenience Mart all clear; continuing patrols.
Bottom half of Albert Street all clear; patrolling Swanson Street West.
Swanson Street all clear; arrived at Federal Square, commencing sweep.
Full sweep Federal Square, Liston House and outside area of the cathedral, all clear; patrolling Federal Street.
Welfare check whole of Federal Street, all clear; patrolling down Victoria Street.
Full sweep whole of Victoria Street West; welfare check Skymart Convenience Store, all clear; patrolling through Elliott Street.
Full sweep Elliott Street; welfare check Elliott Carpark, all clear; patrolling Darby Street.
Full sweep Darby Street, all clear, no issues; patrolling to McDonald's Queen.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen, standing by outside maintaining presence.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street; heading back to office to commence 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ, commencing break while responding to any calls.
Night shift concluded; changeover to the Morning Shift team.
